request.what: Technical Steering Committee support activities for 12 months, spanning community engagement, protocol governance, and independent technical review.

claims.claim: Intersect requests 1,193,000 ADA, stated as $298,250, to fund Technical Steering Committee support for 12 months.
The budget is divided into 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.

The proposal states that the Technical Steering Committee has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the past 24 months, while Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA through listed prior governance actions.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation and audited results.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

Independent audits and assurance for this proposal are to be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect will administer funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, threshold signing rules, and a public dashboard for tracking.
The proposal claims the TSC work supports Cardano strategy pillars including uptime, DRep participation, governance capture resistance, adoption, and treasury stewardship.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for one year of Intersect Technical Steering Committee support, describes three funded work packages, states dependency on the IntersectMBO budget proposal, and provides budget, prior-funding, voting-process, NCL, audit, smart-contract, and oversight details.
